chunks: Hudhayfa ibn Mansur, from Abu Abdillah and Abu al-Hasan (Musa), peace be upon them.
His hadith is not pure, he narrates the authentic and the weak, his affair is ambiguous, and he is used as a witness.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan (Imam Musa al-Kazim, peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the status of Hudhayfa ibn Mansur in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry describes Hudhayfa ibn Mansur al-Khuzai, a narrator of the Imams. It notes that his hadith are not considered pure because he mixes authentic narrations with weak ones, his status is somewhat ambiguous, but he is still accepted as a witness (shahid) in hadith transmission.
